provenance.method: Theil-Sen (median pairwise slope, median intercept) on a mechanically-curated flag-free, tight-interval card set; frozen thereafter. Re-seeded for v2 with the round-13 scoring (13 rounds of §S3 valuation fixes) — same curation philosophy as v1 (simple, confidently-scored cards only, NOT the judged meta), NOT the full population, to preserve the maintainer's 'no circular goalposts' ruling.
provenance.recalibrationReason: v1 (2026-07-14, char slope 1.9) predated 13 audit rounds of honest valuation fixes. Re-seeding on the flag-free simple cards with round-13 scoring moves the CHARACTER line only 1.9 -> 2.0 (~5% rarity-adjusted — the simple-card baseline barely changed); the larger drift is in the SPELLS/EQUIPMENT line (slope 0.2 -> 0.5, intercept 2.2 -> 1.4) as spell/equipment valuation matured, plus the leave-one-faction-out stability bound needing to widen to 20% (see stabilityContract). NOTE: an earlier analysis reported a ~16% character drift; that was an artifact of a rarity-offset omission in the stability-test computation (fixed) — the real rarity-adjusted drift is ~5%. Maintainer authorized the v2 re-seed 2026-07-18.
provenance.note: Rarity offsets are DECLARED from the existing RARITY_BONUS constants in balance-data.mjs, lifted as-is (not re-derived, so rarity is never double-counted through the fitted intercept) — unchanged from v1. Abstract design constants: judge cost-for-power against this frozen line, never against the pool being judged. Bump the version to recalibrate.
provenance.stabilityContract: leave-one-faction-out: characters slope moves < 22% relative (measured worst 20.0%, drop Radiant, + ~2pp margin mirroring v1's 15%-for-12.6%); spells/equipment line disagrees by < one tolerance across the cost range (measured worst material shift 0.90 < tolerance 1.5). The character bound is RELAXED from v1's 13-15% to ~20%, RATIFIED by the maintainer 2026-07-18 (explicit in-session choice: 'simple cards + wider bound'): v2 keeps v1's flag-free 'simple, confidently-scored' curation (NOT the full population — that would reintroduce the circularity the maintainer rejected), and that confidently-scored set shrank as honest §S3 dynamic-amount flags accumulated (Sapphire down to 4 characters), so a leave-one-faction-out over the smaller, faction-imbalanced set is inherently wider.
